universe_or_base: The local route on the two reforms that adopt ranked-choice voting
qualification: V7's route definition for LOC: State home-rule law and preemption, a higher government limiting what a lower one may do. In Dillon's Rule states, where cities hold only the powers the state grants, the legislature can override local choices at will; 19 states prohibit ranked-choice voting in some or all elections.
